title: ARMOR: Manifold-Oriented Training for Adversarially Robust Aerial Object Detection under Data Scarcity
abstract: arXiv:2608.29510v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Aerial object detection is increasingly deployed in real-world applications, but models remain vulnerable to physical, universal adversarial patches that cause them to miss objects. Furthermore, defenders face the practical constraint of training data scarcity: aerial imagery is costly to collect and label, so a deployment site typically yields hundreds of images rather than the tens of thousands that adversarial robustness benchmarks assume. To tackle model vulnerability and training data scarcity, we propose Adversarial Robustness with Manifold-Oriented Training (ARMOR), a novel defense that realizes the core insights of on-manifold adversarial training (OMAT) in low-data regimes. ARMOR builds on the insight of OMAT to model the data manifold - the compact structure capturing the data's relevant features - to learn and robustify these features during training. translated_abstract: 航空目标检测正日益被部署到实际应用中，但模型仍然容易受到物理的、通用对抗补丁的攻击，这些补丁会导致模型漏检目标。此外，防御者还面临训练数据稀缺的实际约束：航空图像的采集和标注成本高昂，因此一个部署站点通常只能提供数百张图像，而非对抗鲁棒性基准测试所假设的数万张图像。为了解决模型脆弱性和训练数据稀缺这两个问题，我们提出了基于流形导向训练的对抗鲁棒性方法（ARMOR），这是一种新颖的防御方法，在低数据量场景下实现了流形上对抗训练（OMAT）的核心思想。ARMOR 建立在 OMAT 的洞察之上，即对数据流形——捕捉数据相关特征的紧凑结构——进行建模，从而在训练过程中学习并增强这些特征的鲁棒性。尽管 OMAT 依赖于训练大型生成……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了ARMOR方法，通过流形导向的对抗训练，在训练数据仅有数百张图像的稀缺条件下，实现对物理通用对抗补丁攻击具有鲁棒性的航空目标检测。
en_tdlr: ARMOR introduces manifold-oriented adversarial training to achieve robust aerial object detection against physical universal adversarial patches under severe training data scarcity.
